directions: Plant in slightly acidic, well-drained, fertile soil in full sun; Rainbow Knock Out is a member of the breakthrough Knock Out rose family, sharing the original cultivar's outstanding disease resistance, self-cleaning habit, and continuous bloom, but distinguished by single, coral-pink flowers with a bright yellow center and a fine, contrasting picotee edge that fades to a softer pink as each bloom ages, so a mature bush shows several shades of pink and coral at once. It blooms from late spring through frost in repeated flushes, requires no deadheading, and shows the same outstanding resistance to black spot that made the original Knock Out a landscaping standard in humid, disease-prone climates. Prune hard, to about 12-18 inches, in late winter; little other maintenance is needed through the season beyond routine watering and feeding. In zone 9, apply 2-3 inches of mulch over the root zone to conserve moisture and moderate soil temperature through peak summer heat.
